detail.method: one warp per SM; each iteration issues U independent 128-bit L2-missing loads and the next iteration depends on their data; cycles per iteration stay at the latency while all U overlap and grow once U exceeds the per-warp outstanding limit (largest U within 1.3x the U=1 cycles)

method: bandwidth vs resident warps (DRAM and L2), per-warp MLP, per-SM outstanding requests, issue width, dependent-chain latencies (Volkov 2016; Jia et al. 2018)
